## History

When her parents were away, Minnie May fell severely ill with croup. [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) sought help at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spent the night nursing Minnie May until [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) returned with a doctor. The doctor praised Anne's skill, which saved Minnie May and convinced Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) to forgive [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and allow her and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to resume their friendship.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P31](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0031), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P35](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P43](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0043)_

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--minnie-may.md)

[Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) saved Minnie May's life by nursing her through a severe night of croup while Minnie May's parents were away. Drawing on her past experience caring for young children, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) managed the illness until medical help arrived, earning the praise of the attending doctor. This act of rescue also led to Minnie May's mother forgiving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and restoring Anne's friendship with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P31](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0031), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P35](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0035), +1 more_
